title: Replication data and Stata analysis code for How innovative industrial clusters affect entrepreneurship in Chinese cities
description: This first replication record contains processed city-level panel data and Stata empirical-analysis code for a study of China's innovative industrial cluster policy across 284 cities from 2009 to 2024. It also includes spatial-weight inputs and matrices, annual Moran's I results and reported result tables. Figure-source data and full figure-generation code will be deposited in a separate linked DOI record. The original firm-level registration data are not included.
